annotations.text:
FIRST OPEN
Welcome → who's lifting (name, weight, goal → suggested calories) → gym days + usual time → pair with your bro by code. Three screens, nothing else asked. Everything the dashboard shows comes from here.

DASHBOARD
Week strip: ember dot = gym day, ember check = attended, white = today. Next-session card: time, countdown, who's in. Before you confirm, the primary button is "I'm in"; once both are in (shown) it becomes "Start workout". Same screen in Polish on the right.

TRAINING
Set rows carry last session's numbers as ghost values. Ticking a set auto-starts the rest timer (pill at the bottom, full screen on tap, Live Activity on the Lock Screen). The PR hint appears the moment a set beats your best. Finish → summary with volume delta, PRs and set records.

PROGRESS
Root lists every lift with its estimated 1RM sparkline and delta; tap for the detail: e1RM chart with PR markers, weekly volume, records. Body weight uses a smoothed trend line over raw weigh-ins.

GYM BRO
One shared week for both, today's status, canned heads-ups (Can't make it / 15 min late) plus a short note. Can't make it → reason + proposed make-up day → logged as missed on both phones. Log shows who showed up.

FUEL
Three ways in: AI photo (editable list, confidence shown, guesses tagged, disclaimer), barcode, or product search backed by Open Food Facts with Polish products. Portion sheet does the math.

DIRECTION A (all screens above): near-black, white primary actions, ember reserved for progress and the next session. Two alternates beside for comparison — B is the safe native-iOS look (blue, grouped cards), C is loud brutalist hazard-yellow. Pick one; A is the recommendation.
